headline: Judge lets NAACP's Clean Air Act lawsuit against xAI data centers proceed
summary: A judge rejected xAI's bid to dismiss an NAACP lawsuit alleging its SpaceX-owned data-center operation violates the Clean Air Act, ruling that mobile gas turbines are not exempt from air permits. Outlets described the lawsuit as centering on xAI's data-center operations, with one locating them near Memphis and another in Mississippi.
